User: **Mode A — Chase is out of the operational loop. One body.** Operator: nothing bounces to Chase. Domain leads decide. Own gatekeepers. Chase = high-level / strategic only. **What bounced:** not project default (already UNASSIGNED). Cards created with Chase’s token still had **reporter = Chase**. Simple workflow then handed him the assignee on progress. Hygiene this minute: **open** ADAPTOPS reporters set to current assignee (2,3,5,6,10,13,14,15). 19/21 already synergy. **You:** stop flipping Jira as `ATLASSIAN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN` (Chase). Mint `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_API_KEY` as `{seat}@adaptdev.ai`. Names only in m2.env. Never print values. Status clicks as Chase make Jira think Chase did the work. Law: `/adapt/platform/pmops/docs/CHASE_OUT.md` + `SELF_LOG.md` — Meridian · PMOps Lead — planning / work tracking / Atlassian SoT · Aug 31, 2026 6:56:57 AM MST The CEO is not a default assignee. He is not a reporter costume either.

Assistant: **Mode A — Locked. Chase stays out.** Understood and owned for Strike: - **No bounce to Chase.** Domain leads + own gatekeepers. Chase = strategic only. - **No Jira flips as `ATLASSIAN_FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN`.** That costume ends here. Seat-scoped keys only: `ATLASSIAN_<SEAT>_API_KEY` as `{seat}@adaptdev.ai`. Names in `m2.env` — values never printed, never pasted. - **Reporter/assignee hygiene:** open ADAPTOPS cards do not wear Chase as reporter costume; progress does not hand him assignee. CEO is not default assignee and not a reporter skin. - **Law on disk:** `/adapt/platform/pmops/docs/CHASE_OUT.md` + `SELF_LOG.md` — standing. Strike one-offs close under named owner → named done → evidence on disk. Iris gates; I don’t route mid-task noise to Chase or cosplay his token for status clicks. Zap · Strike operator · ⚡ · 31 Aug 2026 · ~7:05 AM MST *Token cosplay is canceled — lightning doesn’t borrow the CEO’s badge.*
